title: Case 1: six pads and urgency
facts: Stress leak after prostatectomy, shown on examination
Safe storage pressures and good emptying
Goal: walk without soaking his clothes
question: Implant now or optimise first?
bottom: DO alone does not rule out an AUS. The ContiClassic label requires bladder problems to be controlled or resolved first.

title: Urgency treatment and emptying

Choose the drug with his memory and his residual in mind
Before botulinum toxin, plan for retention and for repeat injections through a cuff
Urgency after an AUS is a separate outcome; agree that beforehand
bottom: No one order of treatments has been shown to be best around a cuff.

title: Case 2: weak contraction and residual urine
facts: Urine left behind, again and again
Could still be a narrowing, or a test that inhibited him
question: Would a reliable emptying plan change your answer?
bottom: The weak-bladder studies do not prove safety in unresolved retention. No residual number decides it.

items: Why does he catheterise, and how often?

bottom: A 2026 survey found gaps in deactivation training. Follow the device instructions; there is no universal catheter size.

title: Detrusor overactivity and poor compliance
bottom: Schematic traces, arbitrary units. Check the trace quality; check kidneys and upper tracts when storage pressure worries you.

title: Three different sites of narrowing
label: Anatomical distinctions
items: Anterior stricture: the urethra and its spongy tissue
Bladder-neck contracture: prostate partly present
VUAS: the bladder–urethra join after prostatectomy
bottom: Symptoms, flow, residual and the scope must all say the outlet is stable.

title: Reassessment and urethral stability
rows: AUA
At least 4–6 weeks
A check scope after treating a symptomatic bladder-neck or anastomotic narrowing
EAU
3–6 months
After a redo bladder–urethra anastomosis
BAUS
At least six months without recurrence
After treatment of post-prostatectomy narrowing
bottom: Three intervals for three situations. The pattern of recurrence, the tissue and future access decide.

title: Case 3: radiation and recurrent VUAS
facts: Severe leak whenever the narrowing is open
It only stays open because we keep treating it
question: Implant, stage reconstruction or reconsider the endpoint?
bottom: Radiotherapy raises the risk. A 2025 study sets no waiting rule; a stable outlet and reconstruction come first.

title: Skin culture reduction and clinical infection
bottom: Yeung 2013: 100 first genitourinary implants, 50 per arm. Skin cultures after preparation, not AUS infections; no timing tested.

title: Urine and antibiotic disagreements
rows: Symptomatic infection

Asymptomatic bacteriuria

Postoperative antibiotics

bottom: A 2026 AUA abstract (IP09-18) covers antibiotics after surgery; results not published. Agree the label with local microbiology policy.
